solutionCode.python:

    def __init__(self):

        config.slot0.k_p = 10
        config.slot0.k_i = 0
        config.slot0.k_d = 0
        config.motion_magic.motion_magic_cruise_velocity = 80
        config.motion_magic.motion_magic_acceleration = 160

title: Hardware in Constructors
description: Create a TalonFX motor named elevatorMotor with device ID 5. In the constructor, create a TalonFXConfiguration object, set Slot0.kP to 10, and apply the configuration to the motor using the motor's configurator.

solutionCode.python:
from phoenix6.hardware import TalonFX
from phoenix6.configs import TalonFXConfiguration

class ElevatorSubsystem:
    elevator_motor = TalonFX(5)

    def __init__(self):
        config = TalonFXConfiguration()
        config.slot0.k_p = 10
        self.elevator_motor.configurator.apply(config)
